offers_products.reason: Designs and sells baby and children's apparel, plus Skip Hop gear and OshKosh B'gosh clothing.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from apparel and accessories; the credit card is issued by Comenity Capital Bank, not the company.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Parents and families buy through Carter's stores and carters.com, oshkosh.com and skiphop.com.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale channel sells Carter's brands to retailers such as department stores, mass merchants and online retailers for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Families repeatedly buy children's clothing as kids outgrow it; loyalty rewards encourage repeat purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Baby and kids' basics are needed as children grow, and are low-priced, so demand holds up in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced clothing items, bought often in small baskets.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured apparel goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households, with wholesale to retailers as the secondary channel.

asset_heavy.reason: Contract factories make the goods, and the company leases its retail stores, so capital needs are modest.

notes: Retail and wholesale both matter; the website text only describes the consumer side.
